question: Which of the following Computer viruses damages the formatting of a document and does NOT allow it to edit?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Macro**__ __**Virus**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A macro virus is a type of malicious software encoded as a macro, which is a** series of commands and instructions.**
 
• Typically written in macro languages used by these applications, such as **VBA (Visual Basic for Applications)** for Microsoft Office documents.
 
• **Concept Virus**: One of the earliest and most famous macro viruses, which appeared in **1995 and targeted Microsoft Word documents**.
 
• Often spread through **email attachments or files downloaded from the internet**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A boot sector virus is a type of malware that infects the boot sector of floppy disks or the **Master Boot Record (MBR)** of hard disks.
 
• First Discovery: One of the earliest and most famous boot sector viruses is the **Brain virus discovered in 1986**.
 
• It was created by** Basit Farooq Alvi and Amjad Farooq Alvi,** who were Pakistani brothers.
 
• The first well-known **computer worm **is the **Morris worm**, also known as the **Internet Worm** was released on **November 2, 1988.**
 
• **Robert Tappan Morris,** a graduate student at Cornell University, created the Morris worm.
 
• The **first file virus** to affect PCs was the **Lehigh** **virus**. The Lehigh virus was discovered in **1987**.
 
• It was named after **Lehigh University** in the United States, where the virus was first identified on campus.
